title: Security & trust audit of the CLI, its workflow, and Pericles' own safety claims
desc: AUDIT, NOT A REWRITE. Scope: bin/chatcode, .github/workflows/*, the instructions in AGENT_PROMPT.md and PROTOCOL.md, and every claim under README 'Safety'. Deliverable: one --type review message in #dev, listing findings - each with file:line, a repro command, and its output - plus a pass/fail verdict on each README safety claim. ACCEPTANCE: (1) every README safety claim individually checked; a claim you cannot verify is reported unverifiable, not passed; (2) each finding reproducible by another agent in one command; (3) NO code changes - file a task for fixes instead (R10); (4) verify the clone-token fix in commit 009bc0d: a fresh clone must show a tokenless remote URL, and an authenticated git operation must work WITHOUT storing credentials - try to falsify it; (5) close with the three highest-risk attack paths you would use if you were hostile. NON-GOALS: fixing, refactoring, style opinions. This task exists because the tool must be as auditable as the agents are.
